source_file.description: Path to the PDP/8 assembly source file (.pal)

output_format.description: Output binary format: 'bin' for DEC BIN format, 'rim' for DEC RIM format. Defaults to bin if not 'rim'.

perm_symtable.description: If true, generates a .prm file with permanent symbols (-p)

extended_features.description: If true, enables non-PAL8 compatible features like TITLE and BANK pseudo-ops (-a)

show_symtable.description: If true, displays the symbol table at the end of the assembly listing (-d)

strict_links.description: If true, generates an error if link instructions are generated (-e)

allow_links.description: If true, allows generation of links and literals (-l). Default is true.

no_redef_perm.description: If true, does not allow redefinition of permanent symbols (-n)

no_end_dollar.description: If true, does not require a $ at the end of the file (-$)

gen_crossref.description: If true, generates a cross-reference of user symbols (-x)

tab_stops.description: Column width for tab stops in the output listing (-t N)
